description: Source code for the MCUX RGPIO driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, port operations, interrupt handling, and device initialization for NXP i.MX series.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting pinmux, pull-up/down, drive mode, and initial output state.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the current raw input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins simultaneously based on mask and value.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_manage_callback
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a callback for GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: mcux_rgpio_port_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling GPIO port interrupts and invoking callbacks.
